metadata.article_title: Penalty for failure to comply with the provisions of section 254.

article.title: Penalty for failure to comply with the provisions of section 254.
article.content:
466Penalty for failure to comply with the provisions of section 254.

Section 466  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 552 of the Act
If a person fails to comply with the provisions of section 254, the Joint Commissioner, Deputy Director or Assistant Director or the Assessing Officer, may impose a penalty which may extend up to Rs. 13[25000] on him.
13 Sub. for "1000" by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026.
